lines.zh: 四只脚陷进泥里，拔出来很费劲。
lines.en: Four feet sink in mud; pulling out is hard work.

lines.zh: 别看我慢，我一伸脖子能咬到你。
lines.en: I look slow, but my neck reaches you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水没过我的裙甲。
lines.en: Swamp water covers the edge of my shell.

lines.zh: 我踩断了一根芦苇，声音很脆。
lines.en: I snap a reed; it cracks sharply.

lines.zh: 壳上的苔藓越来越厚了。
lines.en: The moss on my shell grows thicker.

lines.zh: 我走一步，泥就咕嘟一声。
lines.en: Each step makes the mud gulp.

lines.zh: 这条水道我走了二十年。
lines.en: I have walked this channel for twenty years.
Do not block me; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在后面，扫开落叶。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, sweeping leaves.

lines.zh: 我闻到了鱼腥味，往那边走。
lines.en: I smell fish; I head that way.
My claws dig into the wet earth.

lines.zh: 背着这壳，走一步像走三里。
lines.en: With this shell, each step feels like three miles.

lines.zh: 水面浮着绿藻，我就在下面走。
lines.en: Green algae floats above; I walk beneath it.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，我会回头。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; I will turn around.

lines.zh: 我爬到水边，把头探进去看看。
lines.en: I crawl to the water and dip my head in.

lines.zh: 苔藓太长，挂住了一根树枝。
lines.en: My moss grows long and snags on a branch.
blub, the surface is singing.
My fins ache; a little longer.
Who moved the shipwreck here?
Slow down, don't wake the coral.
I smell salt from far away.
Something stirs beneath the sand.
The water's colder than yesterday.
Let me through, I want deeper water.
This undercurrent is a nuisance.
Don't fall behind, follow my tail.
Past this stretch, then I rest.
So much kelp along this route.
Bubbles are following me around.
Who muddied the water here?
I think I looped back again.
One flick of the tail, off I go.

lines.zh: 我把脖子缩回去，谁都别碰。
lines.en: I pull my neck in; nobody touch it.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着壳，暖得很舒服。
lines.en: The sun warms my shell pleasantly.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，慢慢等，不着急。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and wait, unhurried.
Moss has made its home on my back.

lines.zh: 一动不动，是我最擅长的。
lines.en: Holding perfectly still is my specialty.
Water runs past my feet; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 老了，眼睛上蒙了一层膜。
lines.en: Old now; a film covers my eyes.
I hear frogs; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路，一道都没少。
lines.en: Every ridge on my shell is still there.

lines.zh: 谁在水面上动？我眯眼看看。
lines.en: Something stirs on the surface; I squint.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在泥岸上，歇一歇。
lines.en: I rest my head on the muddy bank.
This armor weighs more than iron plate.

lines.zh: 沼泽安安静静的，正合我意。
lines.en: The swamp is quiet, just as I like.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，嘴张得很大。
lines.en: I yawn, and my mouth opens very wide.
A little patch of sky leaks down.
I wonder how deep the sea goes.
So quiet, just the water.
That seagrass sways so slowly.
I'm waiting for a school to pass.
The tide pushes; I stay put.
Water... it really is water.
This coral looks like a city.
Which fish was I counting?
The moss on this rock is soft.
A boat's shadow just passed over.
A bubble popped. And another.
I should probably surface for air.
My reflection is watching me.
You stand too close; back away.

lines.zh: 我这喙，连骨头都能咬断。
lines.en: This beak can crack bone.

lines.zh: 你在看我的壳？上面全是苔。
lines.en: Looking at my shell? It is all moss.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我警告过了。
lines.en: Do not reach in; I have warned you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进我的泥里了。
lines.en: Your boots are in my mud.
I have lived long; I do not fear you.
Did you bring shears?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小，可看得清你。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我壳上的苔藓认识你吗。
lines.en: Does the moss on my shell know you?

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就伸脖子。
lines.en: One more step, and my neck comes out.
The water changes when you come near.
Your bubbles are much bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 你手里那个亮东西是啥？
lines.en: What's that shiny thing in your hand?
You can swim. Barely.
Don't step on that coral.

lines.zh: 我壳上的苔藓，剪下来有用。
lines.en: The moss on my shell is worth cutting.
Alligator Snapping Turtle? I'll remember that.
The way you came down was funny.
You smell of fishhooks.
How long can you hold your breath?

lines.zh: 我的壳挡了大半，剩下的我忍了。
lines.en: My shell took most of it; I bear the rest.

lines.zh: 你打得我壳上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: Now there is a pale scratch on my shell.

lines.zh: 别敲我的背，那声音难听。
lines.en: Do not tap my back; it sounds awful.
I ducked my head; not from fear.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起被鳄鱼咬过。
lines.en: This reminds me of the time a crocodile bit me.
A small crack in the shell, no matter.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，沼泽都听见了。
lines.en: I grunted; the whole swamp heard.
Old bones do not take many blows.

lines.zh: 退后，我要把脖子伸出来了。
lines.en: Back off; my neck is coming out.

lines.zh: 你手劲不小，可惜我壳厚。
lines.en: Strong hands, but my shell is thick.
That hit landed hard.
Why does the water taste of iron?
It makes me spin.
Who set hooks in here?
Easy, my shell is thin.
I lost a scale.
Not a second time.
Back off. I can still bite.

lines.zh: 龟壳上又多了几个牙印。
lines.en: A few more tooth marks on my shell.
I should hide in the reef.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味…我的脖子自己伸出去了。
lines.en: That fish smell... my neck stretches out on its own.

lines.zh: 你手里那点肉，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that bit of meat in your hand.
Stop waving it; my beak itches.

lines.zh: 我慢慢过来，你别急着跑。
lines.en: I come slowly; do not rush off.

lines.zh: 这味道，比我背上的苔藓香。
lines.en: This smells better than the moss on my back.

lines.zh: 我张大了嘴，你自己看着办。
lines.en: I open wide; decide for yourself.

lines.zh: 给一口，我就当没咬过你。
lines.en: One bite for me, and I forget biting you.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没什么好东西，除了这个。
lines.en: The swamp offers little, except this.
Short legs; I cannot chase. Do not tease me.

lines.zh: 香味顺着水面漂过来的。
lines.en: The scent drifts over the water.
Am I really this easy to lure?
Don't put it away. Let me look.
I'm hungry, but a little afraid.
Better than seagrass by far.
You take a step, I follow.
I snap the bait down, hook and all.

lines.zh: 我跟着这味道游了很远。
lines.en: I swam far following this smell.
It's the scent of bugs!
May I come a little closer?
Just one sniff, truly.

lines.zh: 撞我？我的壳硬得像石头。
lines.en: Bump me? My shell is hard as stone.
You slipped; do not blame me.
At that, I did not even lift my head.

lines.zh: 别贴着我壳边，那儿最滑。
lines.en: Not along my shell rim; it is slick there.

lines.zh: 你撞得我挪了半步，很少见。
lines.en: You shifted me half a step; that is rare.
The swamp is wide; why crowd me?
My claws grip the ground firmly.
Bump and go; my temper is short.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的背了，快下去。
lines.en: You stepped on my back; get off.
Shell on shell makes a dull sound.
Move — my beak is harder than my shell.

lines.zh: 被你撞得翻壳，我蹬水回正。
lines.en: You flipped me; I kick the water to right myself.
I'm small; I can't take that.
Who bumped me? Never mind.
Who's charging around in here?
Not hurt, just annoyed.
I nearly flipped over that time.
All my bubbles broke.
You're harder than a reef.
Let's each keep our own lane.

lines.zh: 找伴这事，我一年只做一次。
lines.en: Finding a mate, I do once a year.
The female's shell ridges are finer than mine.

lines.zh: 我用脖子蹭她，她就懂了。
lines.en: I rub her with my neck, and she understands.
No sweet words; I only rumble.

lines.zh: 沼泽里安静，正适合这个。
lines.en: The swamp is quiet, which suits this.
If she nips me, I will not flinch.

lines.zh: 产卵的沙岸，得挑个背风处。
lines.en: For the nest, I pick a sheltered sandbank.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，还有人肯要。
lines.en: At my age, someone still wants me.

lines.zh: 两只龟挤在泥里，慢慢挪。
lines.en: Two turtles crowd in the mud, shifting slowly.
Do not watch; walk farther off.
Let's swim as a pair.
This reef is ours now.
I brought you a shell.
The tide will witness for us.
Your color is like dusk.
Don't be shy. Come closer.
It's quiet past the seagrass.
My shell is too hard to bite through.
Let's swim together till dawn.
Your scales are beautiful.
I pick it up with my beak, not hands.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃吗？咬一口试试。
lines.en: Is this edible? I will test it with a bite.

lines.zh: 一块亮晶晶的，跟苔藓不一样。
lines.en: Something shiny, unlike moss.
I bite down and do not let go.

lines.zh: 掉进泥里的，我都懒得捡。
lines.en: What falls in the mud, I leave.

lines.zh: 这壳片，正好垫在我窝里。
lines.en: This shell piece fits my nest.

lines.zh: 爪子太钝，夹不住小东西。
lines.en: My claws are blunt; small things slip.
Picked it up; it is a rotten log.
Do not grab it; I bite.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我还能再塞。
lines.en: My mouth is full, and I can fill it more.
I'll find a place for this.
I'll trade a shell for it.
Yours? Take it back.
If it's useful, I'll keep it.
Hard as stone; can't bite it.
It was tucked under a rock.
Must have fallen from a wreck.
Someone dropped it; I'll hold it.
I'll bury it in the sand.
This can decorate my nest.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在水里动，我盯上了。
lines.en: Something moves in the water; I have it.
Anything near my beak counts as prey.

lines.zh: 它在我射程之内，只差一伸脖。
lines.en: Within reach, one neck-stretch away.
Do not swim so fast; I can wait.
I smell blood, very near.

lines.zh: 泥水下面，我看见了它的脚。
lines.en: Under the murk I see its feet.
This bite must land; no misses.

lines.zh: 谁来我沼泽里乱走，我就咬谁。
lines.en: Whoever wanders my swamp gets bitten.
My neck is already drawn tight.

lines.zh: 小东西，你不知道我有多快。
lines.en: Little thing, you do not know how fast I am.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
You are half a block from my beak.
The current covers me.
I've waited long for this.
bugs is right there.
Don't run. You won't escape.
One splash, and that's it.
Luck's come my way today.
The dangerous one. I strike first.
It has to be mine.
I do not chase; I wait for it to come.
It circles; I turn slowly with it.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子，比它先到。
lines.en: Its shadow reaches me before it does.

lines.zh: 等它游进我喙够得着的水域。
lines.en: Waiting for it to drift into reach of my beak.

lines.zh: 我把身子沉下去，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I sink my body, leaving only my eyes.

lines.zh: 它要是转身跑，我也来得及。
lines.en: If it turns to flee, I still have time.

lines.zh: 沼泽帮我藏着，它看不见我。
lines.en: The swamp hides me; it cannot see me.
I have patience; it does not.
Its breathing grows more frantic.

lines.zh: 就等它低头喝水的那一下。
lines.en: Just waiting for it to lower its head and drink.
I own this channel.
I know these waters well.
I can smell you still.
I have plenty of patience.
Run, the shallows won't save you.
I lie in the mud with only my eyes showing.
I never quit halfway.
Hiding won't help you.
Chasing you beats chasing fish.
Hear that? The water counts for me.
A snap, and it is caught.
My beak shuts faster than a door.
This bite takes shell and all.
Do not struggle; the more you do, the harder I bite.

lines.zh: 泥水溅起来，糊了它一脸。
lines.en: Mud splashes up, covering its face.

lines.zh: 我咬完就缩回去，你打不着。
lines.en: I bite and withdraw; you cannot hit me.

lines.zh: 这口咬在你腿上，记住了。
lines.en: This one takes your leg; remember it.

lines.zh: 我活了这么久，靠的就是这一口。
lines.en: I lived this long on this one bite.

lines.zh: 血混进沼泽水里，淡淡的。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the swamp, faintly.
I let go; you should thank me.
Get out of my waters.
You're fast. I'm faster.
Taste it? That's salt.
I'm holding back, still.
That one's for my school.
I'll knock you crooked.
Thought I was easy?
blub, take this one.
You touched my coral?
Remember this one.

lines.zh: 我从淤泥里拱出来，壳上全是水。
lines.en: I heave out of the silt, shell dripping.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽，我出生就在这里。
lines.en: This swamp is where I was born.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是浮萍和雾。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was duckweed and mist.

lines.zh: 我的壳还软，可嘴已经硬了。
lines.en: My shell was soft, but my beak was hard.

lines.zh: 水面上的雾，跟我一起来的。
lines.en: The mist on the water came with me.
This mud again; I know it well.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬上岸，找块石头晒背。
lines.en: I crawl ashore to sun my back on a stone.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的青蛙，都让开道。
lines.en: The frogs of the swamp make way.

lines.zh: 我背上还没有苔，等着吧。
lines.en: No moss on my back yet; just wait.

lines.zh: 老龟也有重新开始的时候。
lines.en: Even an old turtle gets a fresh start.
Water's cold. Feels good.
Let me find a reef to hide in.
I just came out of an egg.
I remember this place.
Where am I? Such deep blue.
New water. New smell.

lines.zh: 我背上的棱，像三排山脊。
lines.en: The ridges on my back look like three ranges.
Deep breath... I have no lungs.
Anyone near? Probably not.
I just got to these waters.
My shell heats up; I slide into the water.
Hot! The water's boiling!

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，壳替我扛了。
lines.en: I land on stone; the shell takes it.
The sand hit me hard.

lines.zh: 我在水下待惯了，淹不着。
lines.en: I live underwater; I will not drown.
I can't hold it. Put me back.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了个身，四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto my back.
Who set off a blast down here?
An arrow sticks in my shell like a weed.
An arrow! Even underwater.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳缝，凉丝丝的。
lines.en: Magic seeps through the shell seams, cool and strange.
This pain isn't natural. Magic.
A few hungry days are fine; I can wait.
I can't even chew seagrass.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell; I flinch once.
My scales are still numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我不喜欢。
lines.en: No mud in the void; I dislike it.
I'm sinking, and there's no floor.
